'''Erik Petersen''' (also written '''Erik Peterson''') won the [[1997 Yavin 4 Regionals (Virginia Beach)]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"McLEAN, VIRGINIA."

"I'm 26 years-old and an intellectual property attorney in Fairfax, Virginia. A die-hard Star Wars fan, I began playing the game from its initial release. My favorite Dark Side card is Blizzard Scout 1, dubbed the 'chicken walker,' while my favorite Light Side card is Uncontrollable Fury (for the image). I'd like to mention (and thank) my friend, Star Wars CCG competitor, mentor, and all around 'Yoda' kind of guy, Kevin Martilla."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/petersen.html Erik Petersen], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428032303/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/petersen.html Internet Archive]</ref>
